title: tenant-audit census: shard the ledger per package and drop live totals from the page
body:
Fixes #33942

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：租户审计普查(tenant-audit census)的台账按包拆成分片(每个包一个文件，带该包自己的小计和全部调用点),页面正文不再写任何实时总数，总数改由门禁每次运行时打印。另外把三处还按「单文件台账」描述普查的注释改成了现在的样子(合并驱动台账、`.gitattributes` 注释、`service-settings` 里一条 JSDoc)。
- 为什么改：以前每个新增写调用点的 PR 都要改同一页和同一个台账里的总数，任意两个这样的 PR 必然冲突;现在两个 PR 在不同包里加写调用点，各改各的分片文件，互不冲突。
- 风险与回滚：只动仓内脚本、文档和一条包内注释(`config-change-audit.ts`,纯注释，不改行为，不进任何导出),不发布行为变化;门禁仍然逐字节核对每个分片(每个包的小计之和就是原总数，所以原来能拦的现在都拦);回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs`(分片缺失/多余/漂移三条新规则与正文不得写实时总数),`scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs`(分片渲染与 `--write` 保留已提交的规模块),`scripts/tenant-audit-census-replay.mjs`(两分支回放)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` —— 预期打印一张总数表(写调用点 322 等)和一行 `cite: 3 / 322`,最后一行 `✓ check-tenant-audit-census: OK -- 322 write call sites certified across 18 package shard(s)`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The tenant-audit census used to commit its population totals in three places that every PR adding a write call site rewrote: the page's generated region, the ledger `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` (its `## Totals` table, plus a dated corpus-scale line re-dated on every `--write`), and about two dozen hand-written numbers in the page prose. Any two such PRs conflicted.

- **Shard key: the package.** The ledger's rows and totals move into one file per package, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts/services/PACKAGE.md` and `.../plugins/PACKAGE.md` (18 shards today), for every package holding a write call site or an undefended subtraction. Each shard carries that package's rows, its undefended subtractions and its totals: every field of `census.totals` plus the undefended counts. **No total across packages is committed anywhere**, the same cure the strictness ledger's `.counts/` shards and the liveness `state-counts/` shards already use.
- **Second artefact.** The old ledger file stays at its path as the index: method text and the dated corpus-scale block. It holds no population figure and no list of shards (a list would be one more line every first-site-in-a-new-package PR rewrites).
- **Page.** The generated region keeps the subtraction method and the dated corpus-scale block and drops every population figure. The hand-written prose states no live total. History sentences keep their figures only where dated: the 2026-08-31 over-claim now quotes the figures of the day it was caught (84 / 17 / 67 at a population of 215, read from the page as first committed in 4ecafc78b1), and the 51-verdict and 225 → 227 fixes carry their dates. The deviation table's "this census" column now names the gate's printed figure instead of a number. One stale claim went with the rewrite: "exactly one write call site … targets either" opt-out object (the table read 7).
- **The gate prints the totals.** `node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs` prints every census total (the same `totalsRows` each shard renders) and a `cite:` line on every run, red or green.
- **`--write` keeps the corpus-scale block.** The page region and the index keep their committed scale values and date unless `--write --refresh-scale` asks to re-measure them. The gate never compared those values (the 2026-08-31 split). Re-dating them on every run was the last line two sharded branches would both rewrite. `--refresh-scale` is a new flag name: the seat may rename it.
- **Gate semantics.** Check A (drift) now covers the index, every expected shard, a package with sites and no shard, and a shard for a package the census finds nothing in, all as `[census-drift]` with the same `Fix: --write`. Because each total is a sum of per-package totals, a moved total is a drifted shard. Check B changes from "every prose number equals the census" to "the prose states no live total": the 12 shapes those numbers used to take must match nothing (`[prose-total]`). Checks C and the empty-census and no-region refusals, and the enforced/unenforced split, are unchanged.
- **Descriptions brought up to the sharded shape** (L1 round 1, R1). The `docs/audits/**` and `content/docs/permissions/**` entries of `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED` in `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` and the `.gitattributes` comment block beside the system-context row now name the index, the per-package shards and a page region that holds no population figure. The JSDoc in `packages/services/service-settings/src/config-change-audit.ts` now points at that package's shard instead of a "hand-written prose count" the page no longer has. Comments and ledger prose only; no row, route or code changes.
- `scripts/tenant-audit-census-replay.mjs` is the card's proof (below). It is a measurement, not a CI gate.

## Tests

<details><summary>Two-branch replay (sharded head) and its control (origin/main)</summary>

```text
$ node scripts/tenant-audit-census-replay.mjs --base acc85f8a3d
replay: replay-a (packages/services/service-job) --write touched 1 file(s):
    rewrote docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts/services/service-job.md
replay: replay-b (packages/plugins/plugin-sharing) --write touched 1 file(s):
    rewrote docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts/plugins/plugin-sharing.md
replay: git merge-tree --write-tree replay-a replay-b :: exit 0
replay: merged tree --write :: exit 0; git status --porcelain after it: (empty)
replay: merged tree gate :: exit 0; ✓ check-tenant-audit-census: OK -- 324 write call sites certified across 18 package shard(s) ...
replay: packages/services/service-job/src/tenant-audit-replay-probe.ts certified by its package shard: yes
replay: packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/tenant-audit-replay-probe.ts certified by its package shard: yes
replay: ✓ outcome clean, expected clean

$ node scripts/tenant-audit-census-replay.mjs --base 082f9c2945 --expect conflict    # origin/main, unsharded
replay: replay-a (packages/services/service-job) --write touched 2 file(s):
    rewrote content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx
    rewrote docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md
replay: replay-b (packages/plugins/plugin-sharing) --write touched 2 file(s): (the same two)
replay: git merge-tree --write-tree replay-a replay-b :: exit 1
replay: CONFLICT in 2 path(s):
    content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx
    docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md
replay: ✓ outcome conflict, expected conflict
```

The replay runs in a throwaway `git clone --shared` with no merge driver registered, which is the condition GitHub's server-side merge runs under. It never touches this worktree's refs.
</details>

<details><summary>Gate self-test and gate (before and after: identical totals)</summary>

`node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs --self-test` passes 29 cases, and the generator's own 101 classifier cases are unchanged. The gate prints `Write call sites 322`, decidable 227, run time 95, tenancy-enabled 220, declared off 7, threading a context 251, provably none 12 / 3, unreadable 59 / 32, elevated 181 / 0 / 129, placement 255 / 57 / 5 / 5, object name 141 / 86 / 10 / 85, undefended 1 / 0. Every figure equals the region and ledger it replaces on `origin/main`.

Tests changed because the artefact moved. Each case is named here:
- `A DRIFT`: "an edited count inside the page region" became "an edited line inside the page region", because the region holds no count. "an edited total inside the ledger" became "an edited total inside a shard". The row-deletion case now deletes from a shard. Two cases are new: a package with sites and no shard, and a shard for a package with no sites. The floor goes from 5 to 7.
- `B PROSE`: the four cases now write a live total back into the prose in three former shapes (unreadable-share sentence, deviation row, `Cite N / M`) and expect `[prose-total]`. The fourth is a control: a dated history figure is not a finding.
- `⭐ THE SPLIT`: the control "a population count in the same table" now moves a shard's total beside a moved scale count, because the page table holds no population figure. The other eight cases are unchanged.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: one per new shard rule, on disk, with the real gate CLI</summary>

| mutation (on disk, then restored and proven by `git diff HEAD` empty) | gate |
| :--- | :--- |
| `services/service-job.md` total `6` changed to `5` (via `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1) | exit 1, `[census-drift] ... services/service-job.md is not what the tree produces. First difference at line 17` |
| `services/service-job.md` deleted | exit 1, `[census-drift] the census has write call sites in the package ... services/service-job.md is the shard for, and that shard is not committed` |
| an orphan `plugins/plugin-no-such-package.md` added | exit 1, `[census-drift] ... plugin-no-such-package.md is committed ... but the census finds no write call site` |
| `**59 of the 322 sites are spelled that way**` written back into the prose | exit 1, `[prose-total] ... "sites whose options argument is unreadable"` |

`--write --refresh-scale` was run once and reverted. It rewrites only the dated line and the scale values in the page and the index.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Two PRs that add a write call site in the **same** package still conflict on that package's shard. The card's bar is different packages. Two PRs that each add the **first** site in two new packages create two new files and do not conflict.
- `--write` no longer re-dates the corpus-scale block. Its date now means "last re-measured", and `--refresh-scale` is the way to refresh it.
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` names the page in a comment, and its two commands are unchanged.
- The prose figure "Across 117 declared objects" is kept as is: it is unenforced corpus scale under the 2026-08-31 ruling, and the self-test builds its fixture from it.

## Verification

Round 1 ran at `1277945da8`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 67 families, all 67 exited 0 (four first answered exit 3 because `@objectstack/formula`, `client`, `client-react` and `lint` were unbuilt, and were re-run after building them).

Round 2 (L1 R1, the three description fixes) ran at `e237ebe91b`. The new paths raise the derived set to 99 families. All 99 ran with stdin from `/dev/null`, each exit code captured before any pipe, and all 99 exited 0; `--ran` reconciliation answered 99 derived, 99 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/` in apps and connectors) and was re-run after a full `pnpm build --concurrency=2`; the re-run code is the one recorded. The head was then synced with `main` by the relay (`870f898cf1`, a merge commit; this PR's own diff is unchanged), and `node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs`, its `--self-test` and `pnpm check:merge-driver` were re-run there: all exit 0, 322 sites across 18 shards.

<details><summary>Highlights</summary>

```text
node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs :: exit 0
node scripts/check-tenant-audit-census.mjs --self-test :: exit 0
pnpm check:merge-driver :: exit 0
pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates :: exit 0
pnpm check:docs-audit-scope :: exit 0
pnpm check:scripts-symbol-anchors :: exit 0
pnpm check:system-context-census :: exit 0
pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads :: exit 0

```
</details>

The CI families are cited from this PR's check-runs. No changeset: the diff is repo tooling (root `scripts/`), docs (`content/docs`, `docs/audits`), `.gitattributes`, and one JSDoc comment on a module-local constant in `@objectstack/service-settings`, which changes no emitted code, type or behaviour. It carries `skip-changeset`.
